tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: Use for the injury report: every listed player's status (out, day-to-day), injury and expected return, as captured on the latest day (or the latest on or before date). NBA and WNBA. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Use to find a player's id by name (partial names work), most recent players first. Pass league for the WNBA (wnba), college (ncaam, ncaaw) or Australia's NBL (nbl); default NBA. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Use for a player's profile, per-season averages and shooting splits (regular season and postseason separately) and last 10 games. For every game use get_player_games. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_player_games
tools.description: Use for a player's game log: every game's box-score line with opponent and result, newest first, optionally one season. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Use for a season's statistical leaders (per game, shooting percentages with a volume floor, or totals) from every box score. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Use for team efficiency for a season: pace, offensive, defensive and net rating per 100 possessions, the four factors (eFG%, turnover %, offensive rebound %, free throw rate) and three-point rate, from every box score. Costs 5 credits.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_player_props" is 1712 chars, far longer than this server's median (332). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_prop_probabilities · Private data: get_standings · Public sink: get_schedule, get_game, get_odds, get_line_movement, get_player_props, get_prop_history, get_prop_movement, get_market_odds, get_game_probabilities, get_prop_probabilities, get_alt_lines · Destructive: get_market_odds.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_prop_probabilities · Private data: get_standings · Public sink: get_schedule, get_game, get_odds, get_line_movement, get_player_props, get_prop_history, get_prop_movement, get_market_odds, get_game_probabilities, get_prop_probabilities, get_alt_lines · Destructive: get_market_odds

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
